mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.phone, u.age, u.email FROM "user" u WHERE u.phone = #{phone} LIMIT 50
SELECT id, name, phone AS mobile, age, email FROM "user" WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 50
SELECT id, name, phone, age, email FROM "user" WHERE phone LIKE #{pattern} LIMIT 50
SELECT id, name, phone, age, email FROM "user" WHERE UPPER(phone) = UPPER(#{phone}) LIMIT 50
